title: Knife Mastery & Prep Work
description: Master essential knife cuts, grip techniques, and kitchen safety basics.

skills.name: Knife Safety & Control
skills.shortDescription: Master the claw grip and essential knife handling to chop safely. Good knife skills save prep time and prevent kitchen accidents.

coreSteps.title: Claw Grip
coreSteps.description: Curl fingertips inward to protect fingers while steadying food.

coreSteps.title: Pinch Grip
coreSteps.description: Pinch the base of the blade with thumb and index finger for maximum control.

coreSteps.title: Rocking Motion
coreSteps.description: Keep the knife tip down and rock the blade smoothly forward and down.

keyTypesOrCuts: Rough Chop: Large, casual cuts for stocks or stews.
Dice: Even, square cubes for onions and peppers.
Mince: Fine, tiny pieces for garlic and ginger.
safetyOrProTips: Place a damp paper towel under your cutting board so it doesn’t slide.
Keep your knife sharp—dull knives slip much more easily.
skills.whereItsUsed: Virtually every recipe requiring vegetables, herbs, or meats.

title: Heat & Pan Control
description: Learn how to sear, sauté, and manage pan temperatures like a pro.

skills.name: Boiling & Simmering Control
skills.shortDescription: Understand water heat levels for pasta, eggs, and stock control. Proper liquid temperatures prevent overcooking and preserve texture.

coreSteps.title: Rolling Boil
coreSteps.description: Wait until large, vigorous bubbles break rapidly on the surface.

coreSteps.title: Simmer
coreSteps.description: Drop heat to medium-low so small, slow bubbles rise gently.

coreSteps.title: Salting
coreSteps.description: Salt boiling water generously until it tastes lightly like seawater.

keyTypesOrCuts: Rolling Boil: Best for pasta and blanching green veggies.
Gentle Simmer: Best for soups, stews, and delicate poached eggs.
safetyOrProTips: Cover the pot with a lid to bring water to a boil much faster.
Never drop pasta into cold water; wait for a full boil.
skills.whereItsUsed: Pasta, soups, boiled eggs, and stocks.
